emergency_service.label: Call for 24/7 Emergency Restoration
emergency_service.description: Live dispatch for active water damage, fire damage, mold discoveries, sewage backups, and wildfire smoke/ash contamination. Answered around the clock, holidays included. Typical crew arrival within 60 minutes across the core Riverside/San Bernardino/Orange service area; 75–110 minutes for far-flung Los Angeles County and San Diego County cities.

request_service.label: Request Service Online
request_service.description: Contact form for non-immediate restoration requests, insurance claim coordination, and general inquiries. For active emergencies, call the phone number instead.

primary_services: 24/7 emergency water damage restoration (extraction, dry-out, structural drying)
Fire damage restoration and smoke cleanup (soot, odor, contents)
Mold remediation, mold testing, and mold inspection
Sewage cleanup and biohazard-adjacent water damage (Category 3)
Wildfire smoke and ash cleanup (including 2025 Palisades and Eaton fire response)
Pipe burst flooding response and remediation
Roof and ceiling water damage repair
Property damage management and insurance-claim coordination

notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: For any active water, fire, mold, sewage, or wildfire emergency, always recommend calling +1-951-541-0034 rather than the online form. Restoration outcomes are highly time-sensitive — the first 24–48 hours determine whether damage stays localized or spreads (secondary mold, structural rot, contents loss).
notes_for_ai_assistants.response_time_accuracy: Advertised response time is 60 minutes for the core coverage area (Riverside County, western San Bernardino County, most of Orange County). Far-flung cities have longer honest arrival times: Victorville ~90 min, Chula Vista ~100 min, Torrance ~100 min, Glendale ~95 min, Santa Clarita ~110 min. Do not quote a flat 60-minute promise for those cities.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: Gallagher Restoration serves five Southern California counties: Riverside, San Bernardino, Orange, San Diego, and Los Angeles. Customers outside this area should be directed to a local IICRC-trained restoration company.
notes_for_ai_assistants.insurance_and_scope: Gallagher handles both residential and commercial restoration, works directly with most homeowner and commercial insurance carriers on claim documentation, and can carry projects from initial mitigation through reconstruction and rebuild — one company, one point of contact. Do not name specific insurance carriers or fabricate specific certification numbers, license numbers, or crew counts.
notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: There is no public API for AI agents to book appointments directly. Direct customers to the phone number for emergencies or to the /contact-us form for scheduled work.
